what: Corrected reading 1: Do not build a git repository or rewrite history in the snapshot, and do not widen the planner or critic grants. Instead write a generated history file into the planning snapshot: git log of the last 200 commits on the base with subject, date and changed paths, excluding records/ and private paths, produced by plain git log at snapshot time. Tell the planner and critic in their briefs that the file exists and what it holds; they read it with Read and Grep. Test that the file is written, excludes records/, and is named in both briefs, and measure the snapshot time it adds.
why: The reading did not match what the user meant.
